conclusion: No additional confirmed local static blocker was found in final runner 9e33 after the two declared overlays. This is an UNBOUND proposal, not a launch approval, Python syntax/behavior validation, executed gate result, or qualification PASS.

design_source_correspondence.provenance: All 14 declared origin snippets (11 supervisor helpers, old test_suite, snapshot, observed_test_counts) were checked as unique exact spans of their actual pinned origin bytes. The final composition retains eight supervisor helpers plus snapshot/count parser exactly. kill_owned_group_before_reap, command, git_read and the separately documented remaining helper have explicit semantic deltas; no blanket whole-helper reuse claim is made.
design_source_correspondence.configuration: The embedded FIXED_CONFIG parses to the same complete object as config44ab. C != FIXED_CONFIG rejects extra/missing/substituted keys. UNBOUND state/value, invalid source identities/count/budget, wrong platform/UID or unsafe names refuse before WORK.mkdir, Git or Popen. The nine-suite table is embedded source, not caller-supplied argv.
design_source_correspondence.command_table: All nine original source-plan selectors were independently token-compared to the design table and final actual embedded table. Added locked/offline/retries0/final-output flags are explicit. Actual stages remain four targeted, four full crate, one full workspace; the last has no package/target/filter/feature expansion.
design_source_correspondence.original_qualification: No original seven-package or Root17 configuration fields enter the additional config. The runner neither modifies nor directly invokes 096b, the original checker, formatter/fix, sudo/chown/mount, dependency installation or credential repair. The original artifacts remain unchanged.
design_source_correspondence.source_binding: The actual code checks donor head/tree/clean status, clones to its newly owned work directory, fetches/checks out the bound source, independently hashes the raw commit object, compares its tree, verifies every manifest path/blob and exact count, pins tool/profile/checker source, and performs the original complete physical snapshot before and after. No skip/assume-unchanged/unmerged or unexpected untracked source is accepted.
design_source_correspondence.execution_records: The adapter explicitly names hepta-extra-gates-reviewed-supervisor, retains the actual direct-command record under a separate name, and supplies the unchanged collector with source-head, exact command, clean before/after, aware interval, real command exit and actual terminal counts. It does not label its output as original hepta_ci_exec.
design_source_correspondence.results: Within a stage known ordinary failures are retained; a failed stage prevents broader stages. Any missing/zero selection, failed or mismatched JUnit, build failure, nonzero exit, timeout, unknown completion, changed source/tool/evidence or not-run suite prevents final passed status. All nine must actually run once and pass.

resolved_findings.original_problem: After final Git-read timeout at the original global end, the inherited fixed p.wait(timeout=10) could add another waiting interval.
resolved_findings.verified_resolution: The base proposal's kill helper uses min(10,max(0,DEADLINE-now)). SIGKILL targets only the successfully created owned PGID before leader reap. Lack of time to reap remains unknown/failure.

resolved_findings.original_problem: A relative timeout computed before Popen was reused after Popen, so creation time was not deducted from the same operation interval.
resolved_findings.verified_resolution: command freezes min(original start+cap, global end-120); Git reads freeze their 120-second work or 30-second final cap against the same respective original end. After Popen only the remaining interval is waited. No-time and late return remain completion_unknown. Already-reaped leaders are recorded without signalling their reusable PID; unreaped owned leaders follow kill-before-bounded-reap.

resolved_findings.original_problem: A report was checked during collection, but its later replacement/disappearance before exclusion or final verification was not compared to that last native identity.
resolved_findings.verified_resolution: The actual native identity/hash is kept after collection, compared before the next report exclusion, cleared only after real exclusion/absence, and rechecked for the final remaining native report. All five overlay operations were independently replayed both ways.

focused_code_review.deadline: One START and DEADLINE; work reserves 120 seconds inside that same end. Final EVIDENCE_DEADLINE is that original end. Popen time is charged as above. Synchronous local file operations are not claimed hard-real-time; observed total overrun marks failure.
focused_code_review.pgid: Only start_new_session=True direct commands or Git reads are supervised. Popen failure, interruption, timeout and late observation remain sticky completion_unknown. No nested hepta_ci_exec session is introduced. Reaping the leader is not used as proof that all descendants terminated.
focused_code_review.unknown_completion: test_suite refuses unknown/finalizing before dispatch. A direct-command timeout raises before the collector. Interrupted/unknown records remain incomplete and the final status is incomplete-unknown; no subsequent test or collector is certified.
focused_code_review.junit: The fixed native local path is used; redirection/dangling reports refuse. Prior reports are retained before dispatch. The unchanged collector performs original aware-interval, size/stability, XML declaration, real testcase and terminal-count checks. Native before/after collection identity and retained SHA must agree. Target families use actual executed-name prefixes and exact tests use exact names; skipped cases cannot cover them.
focused_code_review.final_evidence: All observed direct logs and retained execution/XML/summary/prior-report hashes in immutable_artifacts are rechecked; the last native report is checked separately. Full source, source tools, resolved external launch files, fixture bindings and donor identity are checked again. Errors discovered during finalization prevent passed status.
focused_code_review.fixtures: Inherited CARGO_BIN_EXE_* and NEXTEST_BIN_EXE_* are cleared. Only embedded reviewed bindings may inject matching keys, after exact source head/tree, executable file SHA and evidence-file Git hash checks. The current empty injection table is not evidence that all required helper binaries exist.
focused_code_review.exit: Negative child status is retained as command_exit_code and normalized only for the adapter exit field. A completed process cannot pass with zero observed tests or any failed count. Final sys.exit is zero only for the final additional-gates-passed status.

pending_root_binding: Review and bind the exact final source head/tree/manifest/count, current donor identity, and a new exclusive work/attempt.
Provide the actual same-source fixture dependency review and any fixed existing executable/evidence bindings. A valid-looking fixture_evidence_blob string or cache pathname alone is not that review.
Freeze and peer-check the bound script/config/request pins and actual operator invocation. This review covers the unbound program and its fixed command/control logic, not future edited literals.
Retain actual tool/version, helper resolution, complete logs/JUnit and command outcomes from the eventual run; no prior PASS is transferable.
limitations: No Python parse, runner execution, native/Cargo/test/checker/formatter, h/PTy or ref operation was performed by this review.

external_tools before/after hashes the actual selected/resolved launch files. When cargo/rustc resolve to rustup proxies this is not a hash of the entire toolchain installation. Version commands occur once before tests; no post-run version rerun is claimed. The author accepted an index erratum for the design's overbroad hash/versions-before-and-after wording.
The reviewed file/evidence checks assume the trusted ordinary operator execution environment used by the original helpers; they do not authenticate an arbitrary host or arbitrary test command.
The runner preserves existing ignored/platform/environment-return behavior and complete output; an early-return test success is not proof that integration/business behavior ran.
Owned-PGID cleanup and JUnit success do not prove daemon/Root OS exit, independent C adoption, or a complete ordinary business chain.

Derived roster/count/binding JSON is diagnostic evidence; successful certification is bound to the retained original execution/log/XML/summary and actual in-memory comparisons. This review does not claim every derived JSON file has an independent immutable_artifacts entry.
